description: Parse natural-language dates and relative times like "next Friday at 3pm", "in 2 weeks", "tomorrow morning" or "Dec 25 to Jan 2" into exact ISO datetimes, relative to a reference time and time zone. Use before acting on any date a user typed. First 25 calls per day are free, then $0.001 per call (x402).

forward_date.description: Prefer future dates for ambiguous text (default true)

reference.description: ISO 8601 datetime the text is relative to; default now

name: parse_date_text
title: Parse natural-language dates
